key_concepts: Force is a push or pull exerted on an object
A force is an action that changes or maintains motion
Forces can change an object's speed
Forces can change an object's direction
Forces can change an object's shape
Movement is the change in position of an object over time
Rigid objects are hard and cannot be easily bent, deformed, or compressed
Soft objects can be easily bent, deformed, or compressed
Forces can be represented by arrows in diagrams
The arrowhead shows the direction of the force
Arrows representing forces may point upward, downward, right, left, or diagonally
Safety requires awareness of the direction of force and movement when pushing or pulling
